'''Alfie Evan Allen''' (born 12 September 1986) is an English actor. He portrayed [[Theon Greyjoy]] on all eight seasons of the [[HBO]] fantasy series ''[[Game of Thrones]]'' (2011–2019), for which he received a nomination for the [[Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series]] in 2019. In film, he is best known for his starring roles in ''[[John Wick (film)|John Wick]]'' (2014), ''[[The Predator (film)|The Predator]]'' (2018), and ''[[Jojo Rabbit]]'' (2019).

==Early life and education==
Alfie Evan Allen was born on 12 September 1986<ref>{{Citation|title=Fast Life Alfie Allen|url=https://www.facebook.com/biiinge/videos/270198130621901/|language=en|access-date=30 January 2020}}</ref> in [[Hammersmith, London]], the son of film producer [[Alison Owen]] and actor [[Keith Allen (actor)|Keith Allen]]. ==Career==
Allen's first professional appearance was in a one-off [[Channel 4]] comedy, ''You Are Here'' in 1998, co-written by [[Matt Lucas (comedian)|Matt Lucas]] and [[David Walliams]]. The same year, Allen and his sister Lily appeared in the 1998 film [[Elizabeth (film)|''Elizabeth'']], which was produced by their mother.<ref name="northampton"/>

His early work included small roles in ''[[Agent Cody Banks 2: Destination London]]'', directed by his uncle, the film ''[[Atonement (2007 film)|Atonement]]'', and in [[BBC1]]'s historical hospital drama, ''[[Casualty 1907]]'', as Nobby Clark.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/theobserver/2007/sep/09/features.magazine57|work=[[The Observer]]|first=Killian|last=Fox|date=9 September 2009|access-date=24 April 2012|title=Rising star: Alfie Allen, actor|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131005152839/http://www.theguardian.com/theobserver/2007/sep/09/features.magazine57|archive-date=5 October 2013}}</ref> Starting in [[Chichester]] on 31 January 2008, he took over [[Daniel Radcliffe]]'s role in a revival of ''[[Equus (play)|Equus]]'' on a nationwide tour.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/7063699.stm|title=Alfie Allen takes on Equus role|work=BBC News|date=26 October 2007|access-date=23 January 2008|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090123172825/http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/entertainment/7063699.stm|archive-date=23 January 2009}}</ref>

In April 2009, Allen co-starred with then-partner [[Jaime Winstone]] in the music video for "[[Dust Devil (Madness song)|Dust Devil]]" by [[Madness (band)|Madness]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.radiotimes.com/news/2012-04-22/game-of-thrones---alfie-allen-i-want-people-to-know-who-i-am|title=Game of Thrones – Alfie Allen: "I want people to know who I am"|work=[[Radio Times]]|date=22 April 2012|access-date=24 April 2012|first=Ben|last=Matchell|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120423142343/http://www.radiotimes.com/news/2012-04-22/game-of-thrones---alfie-allen-i-want-people-to-know-who-i-am|archive-date=23 April 2012}}</ref> He also had a role in the [[BBC2]] film, ''[[Freefall (2009 film)|Freefall]]''.<ref name="northampton">{{cite web|url=http://www.northamptonchron.co.uk/lifestyle/weekend-life/tv-review/with-a-leading-role-in-the-new-series-of-game-of-thrones-alfie-allen-speaks-about-stepping-out-the-shadow-of-his-famous-family-1-3697229|work=Northampton Chronicle|date=4 April 2012|access-date=24 April 2012|title=With a leading role in the new series of Game of Thrones, Alfie Allen speaks about stepping out the shadow of his famous family|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120510012338/http://www.northamptonchron.co.uk/lifestyle/weekend-life/tv-review/with-a-leading-role-in-the-new-series-of-game-of-thrones-alfie-allen-speaks-about-stepping-out-the-shadow-of-his-famous-family-1-3697229|archive-date=10 May 2012}}</ref> He continued to work in films, appearing in ''Freestyle'', ''[[Soulboy (film)|Soulboy]]'', and ''[[The Kid (2010 film)|The Kid]]'' in 2010.<ref name=Guardian/><ref name=soulboyiv>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z88-sv6mZdo|title=SoulBoy – Alfie Allen|date=1 September 2010|work=YouTube|access-date=24 April 2012|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131205232939/http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z88-sv6mZdo|archive-date=5 December 2013}}</ref>

Allen came to international attention when he was cast as [[Theon Greyjoy]] in the HBO fantasy series ''[[Game of Thrones]]'', an adaptation of [[George R. R. Martin]]'s ''[[A Song of Ice and Fire]]'', in 2011.<ref name="HBOBio">{{cite web |title=Cast & Crew: Theon Greyjoy |url=http://www.hbo.com/game-of-thrones/#/game-of-thrones/cast-and-crew/theon-greyjoy/index.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120424144009/http://www.hbo.com/game-of-thrones#/game-of-thrones/cast-and-crew/theon-greyjoy/index.html |archive-date=24 April 2012 |access-date=24 April 2012 |publisher=[[HBO]]}}</ref><ref name=Guardian>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/stage/2010/sep/05/alfie-allen-interview-alice-fisher|title=Alfie Allen: 'I prefer playing baddies'|author=Fisher, Alice|date=5 September 2010|work=[[The Guardian]]|access-date=5 August 2011|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131005153039/http://www.theguardian.com/stage/2010/sep/05/alfie-allen-interview-alice-fisher|archive-date=5 October 2013}}</ref><ref name="northampton"/> Originally auditioning for the role of [[Jon Snow (character)|Jon Snow]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.denofgeek.com/tv/125-things-we-didnt-know-about-game-of-thrones-season-5/|title=Game Of Thrones season 5: what we learned from the Blu-rays|website=denofgeek.com|date=11 March 2016 |access-date=24 April 2018|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171023073621/http://www.denofgeek.com/tv/game-of-thrones/39270/game-of-thrones-season-5-what-we-learned-from-the-blu-rays#ixzz436hmC8Fh|archive-date=23 October 2017}}</ref> he appeared as a series regular for 8 seasons and was nominated for a [[Primetime Emmy Award]] for Best Supporting Actor in 2019 for the show's final season.<ref>{{cite magazine |title=Alfie Allen reacts to Game of Thrones Emmy nomination |url=https://ew.com/emmys/2019/07/16/alfie-allen-game-of-thrones-emmy-nomination/ |magazine=Entertainment Weekly |access-date=26 June 2020}}</ref>

Allen starred in the 2012 British thriller ''Confine'',<ref name=screendaily>{{cite web|url=http://www.screendaily.com/news/production/daisy-lowe-alfie-allen-to-star-in-london-thriller-confine/5037251.article|title=Daisy Lowe, Alfie Allen to star in London thriller Confine|last=Cooper|first=Sarah|date=1 February 2012|work=[[Screen Daily]]|access-date=24 April 2012|url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120414111827/http://www.screendaily.com/news/production/daisy-lowe-alfie-allen-to-star-in-london-thriller-confine/5037251.article|archive-date=14 April 2012}}</ref> and then opposite [[Keanu Reeves]] in the 2014 film ''[[John Wick (film)|John Wick]]''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Alfie Allen Talks 'John Wick' and 'Game of Thrones Season 5 |url=https://collider.com/alfie-allen-john-wick-game-of-thrones-interview/ |website=Collider |date=23 October 2014 |access-date=26 June 2020}}</ref> In 2016, directed by [[Mike Christie (director)|Mike Christie]], he filmed a two part documentary for the [[History Channel]] titled ''Football: A Brief History'', about the roots of association football.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.history.co.uk/shows/football-brief-history-alfie-allen |publisher=history.co.uk |title=FOOTBALL: A BRIEF HISTORY BY ALFIE ALLEN |work=History |date=24 January 2017 |access-date=26 March 2017 |url-status = live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170326231656/http://www.history.co.uk/shows/football-brief-history-alfie-allen |archive-date=26 March 2017 }}</ref> That same year, he played Ringwood in the [[BBC Two]] 1940s-set miniseries ''[[Close to the Enemy]]'' and joined the London production of [[Jesse Eisenberg]]'s ''The Spoils'' at [[Trafalgar Studios]].<ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://deadline.com/2016/05/alfie-allen-jesse-eisenberg-the-spoils-slow-tv-bbc-four-1201748229/|title=Alfie Allen Joins Jesse Eisenberg's 'The Spoils' In West End Transfer; Slow TV Takes Bus To BBC4 – Global Briefs|journal=Deadline|first=Nancy|last=Tartaglione|date=3 May 2016|access-date=3 September 2022}}</ref>

Allen co-starred in the sci-fi sequel ''[[The Predator (film)|The Predator]]'' as Lynch in 2018, and [[Taika Waititi]]'s [[Academy Awards|Oscar]]-nominated dark comedy ''[[Jojo Rabbit]]'' as Finkel as well as the coming-of-age film ''[[How to Build a Girl]]'' as John Kite in 2019.<ref>{{cite web |title=Game Of Thrones' Alfie Allen Joins Taika Waititi's JoJo Rabbit |url=https://deadline.com/2018/06/alfie-allen-game-of-thrones-jojo-rabbit-taika-waititi-how-to-build-a-girl-1202409830/ |website=Deadline |date=15 June 2018 |access-date=26 June 2020}}</ref> He had a recurring role as Isaac Pincher in the third series of the period drama ''[[Harlots (TV series)|Harlots]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tvinsider.com/802331/harlots-season-3-isaac-pincher-dead-alfie-allen-leaving/ |title='Harlots' Star Breaks Down [Spoiler]'s Season 3 Death & Relationships |last=Jacobs |first=Meredith |date=7 August 2019 |website=TV Insider |access-date=8 August 2019 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190808015430/https://www.tvinsider.com/802331/harlots-season-3-isaac-pincher-dead-alfie-allen-leaving/ |archive-date=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tvinsider.com/807327/alfie-allen-game-of-thrones-theon-harlots-isaac/ |title=Alfie Allen Compares His 'Game of Thrones' & 'Harlots' Characters |last=Jacobs |first=Meredith |date=25 August 2019 |website=TV Insider |access-date=25 August 2019 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201124211105/https://www.tvinsider.com/807327/alfie-allen-game-of-thrones-theon-harlots-isaac/ |archive-date=24 November 2020}}</ref>

In 2020, Allen appeared in the [[ITV (TV channel)|ITV]] crime drama ''[[White House Farm (TV series)|White House Farm]]'' as Brett Collins. Allen made his [[Broadway theatre|Broadway]] debut in 2022 when he took over the role of Mooney from [[Dan Stevens]] in [[Martin McDonagh]]'s ''[[Hangmen (play)|Hangmen]]'' at [[John Golden Theatre]].<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://ew.com/theater/hangmen-first-look-game-of-thrones-alfie-allen-broadway/|title=Get your first look at Game of Thrones star Alfie Allen in Broadway's Hangmen|magazine=Entertainment Weekly|first=Maureen Lee|last=Lenker|date=April 2022|access-date=3 September 2022}}</ref> For his performance, Allen received a [[Tony Award]] nomination for [[Tony Award for Best Featured Actor in a Play|Best Featured Actor in a Play]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://people.com/theater/game-of-thrones-alfie-allen-was-nervous-to-star-on-broadway-the-pressure-just-felt-so-immense/ |title='Game of Thrones' ' Alfie Allen Was Nervous to Star on Broadway: 'The Pressure Just Felt So Immense' |last=Gioia |first=Michael |date=20 May 2022 |website=[[People (magazine)|People]] |access-date=21 May 2022 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220521152245/https://people.com/theater/game-of-thrones-alfie-allen-was-nervous-to-star-on-broadway-the-pressure-just-felt-so-immense/ |archive-date=21 May 2022}}</ref> In 2022, he starred as Lieutenant [[Jock Lewes]] in the [[BBC One]] [[World War II]] miniseries ''[[SAS: Rogue Heroes]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/drama/sas-rogue-heroes-cast-interview-bond/ |title=SAS Rogue Heroes stars on forging a bond during the "tough" shoot |last=Mclean |first=Craig |date=30 October 2022 |website=Radio Times |access-date=30 October 2022 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221030083014/https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/drama/sas-rogue-heroes-cast-interview-bond/ |archive-date=30 October 2022}}</ref>

==Personal life==
From 2017 to 2019, Allen was in a relationship with [[artist]] [[Allie Teilz]], with whom he has a daughter, born in October 2018.<ref name=digi>{{cite web|last1=Edwards|first1=Chris|title=Game of Thrones star Alfie Allen becomes a father for the first time as he welcomes baby girl with girlfriend Allie Teilz|url=http://www.digitalspy.com/tv/game-of-thrones/news/a869053/game-of-thrones-alfie-allen-father-baby-girl-girlfriend-allie-teilz/|website=Digital Spy|date=23 October 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elle.com.au/celebrity/game-of-thrones-actors-real-life-partners-13995|title=Meet The Real-Life Partners Of 'Game Of Thrones' Stars|last=Chandra|first=Jessica|website=Elle Australia|language=en|date=13 May 2019|access-date=7 December 2021}}</ref> He is a supporter of the English football club [[Arsenal F. C.|Arsenal]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/football/winter-is-coming-game-of-thrones-star-alfie-allen-visits-arsenal-for-emirates-stadium-tour-a3395411.html |title='Winter is coming!' – Game of Thrones star Alfie Allen visits Arsenal for Emirates Stadium tour |work=Evening Standard |location=London |date=14 November 2016 |access-date=24 February 2020 }}</ref>
